# Furnmasr (فرنتشر مصر)

> Furnmasr is a bilingual (Arabic / English) e-commerce store specializing in home and
> hotel furniture (أثاث). Arabic is the primary language. The store offers modern
> sectionals, living room sets, bedrooms, lazy boy chairs, and decor pieces with fast
> shipping, secure checkout, and customer reviews.

## Main sections
- [Home](https://furnmasr.com/): Featured products, best sellers, flash sales, new arrivals.
- [Shop](https://furnmasr.com/shop): Full product catalog with category and price filters.
- [Flash Sale](https://furnmasr.com/flash-sale): Time-limited discounted products.
- [Blogs](https://furnmasr.com/blogs): Articles about furniture, interior styling, and caring for your pieces.
- [Contact](https://furnmasr.com/contact): Store contact form and location.

## Product categories
Living room, bedroom, dining and decor furniture. Browse live categories from the catalog at
https://furnmasr.com/shop — each product has its own page at
https://furnmasr.com/shop/{slug} with description, dimensions/pricing, and reviews.
